creator: robert.triebwasser
title: Tour of a self-hosted 'AIOS' personal dashboard built with Claude Code: daily briefing, multi-CLI chat, social metrics, notes, skills, projects, phone access

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: Built the whole dashboard with it; also one of three CLIs operated from the chat tab

tools.name: Gemini CLI
tools.detail: One of the three 'specialists' reachable from the chat tab

tools.name: Codex (OpenAI CLI)
tools.detail: Third CLI operated from the dashboard

tools.name: AIOS (creator's own web app)
tools.detail: Runs at localhost:7777 on a home computer; phone reaches it at 10.117.245.18:7777 (LAN)

claims: Dashboard runs off a home computer that 'basically never turns off' and is accessible from his phone
Homepage gives the top three things to focus on every day
Chat tab operates Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI directly on his computer ('three specialists: one to write, one to research, one to build')
Social media dashboard pulls every comment and metric from all three social channels
Notes auto-clear when the task is done; on-screen: 'quick captures with a 14-day half-life'
Skills tab holds '100+ one-click AI workflows'
Projects tab shows each project with notes and full context history
how_to_steps: No build steps shown; this is a feature tour. Implied architecture: local web server (port 7777) with tabs Daily Briefing, Chat (routes to Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Codex), Social, Notes, Skills, Projects; exposed to phone over the home network
on_screen_only: Title card: 'My AI Operating System THAT RUNS my LIFE'
App header 'AIOS' with sections: Daily Briefing, Your AI Team, Notes, Skills, Projects, Anywhere
Browser URL localhost:7777; phone browser shows 10.117.245.18:7777 (local network IP, not a public URL)

Overlay captions: 'The top 3 things to focus on — every morning', 'Claude · Gemini · Codex — one tap each', 'Capture an idea — clears itself when it's done', '100+ one-click AI workflows', 'Every project + its full context history', 'Runs at home. Lives in your pocket.'

Notes page text: 'Quick captures with a 14-day half-life. Different from Open Loops (committed work) and Chat (transcripts). ⌘+K opens the global capture from any page.' Example note: 'post the new video tomorrow #reminder'
End card: 'AIOS · BUILT WITH AI — Want to build your own? Follow along'

relevance.why: Good picture of what a solo founder's command center could look like (daily top-3, skills as one-click buttons, project context history), but no implementation detail; phone access is LAN-only as shown.

implement_score.why: The pattern (local Node/Python web UI that shells out to Claude Code and stores notes/projects in markdown) is a weekend Claude Code build. Worth borrowing the daily-briefing + skills-as-buttons ideas; full clone is a time sink.

verify: Is the code shared anywhere, or only the promise of future content?
How is phone access secured off the home network (Tailscale/VPN?) — the shown IP is LAN-only
How does the chat tab actually drive Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI (PTY wrapper? SDK?) and what are the auth/cost implications of running all three
How do 'skills' here map to Claude Code skills vs. the creator's own scripts
